input_question: What would the study team still need to confirm before saying I am eligible?

eligibility_assessment.patient_facing_answer: The study team still needs to confirm several things before saying you are eligible, such as your age, health status, and whether you meet all the eligibility criteria listed.
supported_patient_facts: I am not currently undergoing chemotherapy, radiation or surgery
I am in a committed, romantic relationship
I have access to a computer or tablet with internet
I have an email address that I am willing to share with the study team
I am at least 18 years of age and less than 90 years of age
